name: Question 7
problem:
| **Age, in years ($x$)** | $12$ | $12$ | $14$ | $14$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Weight, in lbs ($y$)** | $85$ | $90$ | $97$ | $100$ |

Mike plays baseball. The table above shows the ages and corresponding weights of four of Mike's teammates.
Compute the covariance of the data sets.
worked_solution:
The (population) covariance of the data sets $x={{x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}}$ and $y={{y}_{1},{y}_{2},…,{y}_{n}}$ is given by 

$$
\text{Cov}(x,y)=\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}({x}_{i}-\overset{―}{x})({y}_{i}-\overset{―}{y}),
$$

where $\overset{―}{x}=\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i}$ and $\overset{―}{y}=\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{y}_{i}$ are the means of the data sets.

First, we need to compute the means: 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{x} & =\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i} \\  & =\frac{1}{4}\cdot (12+12+14+14) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}\cdot 52 \\  & =13 \\ \overset{―}{y} & =\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{y}_{i} \\  & =\frac{1}{4}\cdot (85+90+97+100) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}\cdot 372 \\  & =93\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the covariance of our data sets is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Cov}(x,y) & =\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}({x}_{i}-\overset{―}{x})({y}_{i}-\overset{―}{y}) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}[(12\,-\,13)(85\,-\,93)+(12\,-\,13)(90\,-\,93)+(14\,-\,13)(97\,-\,93)+(14\,-\,13)(100\,-\,93)] \\  & =\frac{1}{4}[(-1)(-8)+(-1)(-3)+(1)(4)+(1)(7)] \\  & =\frac{1}{4}[8+3+4+7] \\  & =\frac{1}{4}\cdot 22 \\  & =5.5.\end{aligned}
$$

Mike plays baseball. The table above shows the ages and corresponding weights of four of Mike's teammates. Compute the covariance of the data sets.

Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The (population) covariance of the data sets x={x1,x2,…,xn} and y={y1,y2,…,yn} is given by

Cov(x,y)=1n∑i=1n(xi−x―)(yi−y―),

where x―=1n∑i=1nxi and y―=1n∑i=1nyi are the means of the data sets.

First, we need to compute the means:

x―=1n∑i=1nxi=14⋅(12+12+14+14)=14⋅52=13y―=1n∑i=1nyi=14⋅(85+90+97+100)=14⋅372=93

Therefore, the covariance of our data sets is

Cov(x,y)=1n∑i=1n(xi−x―)(yi−y―)=14[(12−13)(85−93)+(12−13)(90−93)+(14−13)(97−93)+(14−13)(100−93)]=14[(−1)(−8)+(−1)(−3)+(1)(4)+(1)(7)]=14[8+3+4+7]=14⋅22=5.5.
